_about: Tool map for ReconQA's built-in Android driver (drivers/android/server.mjs), used by the write gate. Any tool on this server that is not listed is denied. The driver itself pins one device and one app package from .reconqa/kit.yml and offers no raw shell.

ask_reasons.android_monkey: random taps and typing in the test app (extreme mode); it can create, change or delete data inside the test app
ask_reasons.android_clear_app_data: deletes the test app's data on the device (accounts, settings and records made in the app)
